camel_example: aliyun ndr DescribeBlockingPolicies --region cn-hangzhou --BlockingStatus 1 --PageSize 10 --BlockingType ip --EndTime 1788393600000 --NextToken 'example-string' --MaxResults 10 --StartTime 1788307200000 --SortOrder desc --Page 1 --BlockingDirection in --SortField blocking_time --BlockingEntity '203.0.113.10' --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries blocking policies retained by the current account with paging, including their effective status, expire time, and node statistics
description_zh: 分页查询当前账号保留的封禁策略及生效状态、过期时间和任务统计
kebab_example: aliyun ndr describe-blocking-policies --page 1 --page-size 10 --blocking-type ip --blocking-entity 203.0.113.10 --blocking-direction in --blocking-status 1 --start-time 1788307200000 --end-time 1788393600000 --sort-field blocking_time --sort-order desc --max-results 10 --next-token example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBlockingPolicies

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始，省略时为 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 10. Values less than or equal to 0 are treated as 10, and values greater than 100 are treated as 100. Specify a value from 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，默认 10；小于等于 0 时按 10，大于 100 时按 100。建议传入 1～100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The blocking type filter. ip indicates an IPv4 address, and domain indicates a domain name. If not specified, no type-based filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 封禁类型筛选。ip 表示 IPv4，domain 表示域名；省略时不按类型筛选
parameters.name: blocking_type

parameters.help_en: The blocking entity keyword. Performs a contains match against IPv4 addresses or domain names. If not specified, no entity-based filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 封禁实体关键词，对 IPv4 或域名做包含匹配；省略时不按实体筛选
parameters.name: blocking_entity

parameters.help_en: The direction filter. Performs an exact match against in, out, or bidirectional. If not specified, no direction-based filtering is applied. in does not match bidirectional
parameters.help_zh: 方向筛选，按 in、out 或 bidirectional 精确匹配；省略时不按方向筛选。in 不会同时匹配 bidirectional
parameters.name: blocking_direction

parameters.help_en: The blocking status of the policy. 0 indicates not effective, and 1 indicates effective. To check whether a task is still running, query the task status separately. If not specified, no status-based filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 策略封禁状态。0 表示未生效，1 表示已生效；任务是否仍在执行需另查任务状态。 省略时不按该字段筛选
parameters.name: blocking_status

parameters.help_en: The lower bound of the blocking time query range, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. The boundary is inclusive. If not specified, no lower bound is applied
parameters.help_zh: 策略封禁时间的查询下界，Unix 毫秒时间戳，包含边界；省略时不限制下界
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The upper bound of the blocking time query range, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. The boundary is inclusive. If not specified, no upper bound is applied
parameters.help_zh: 策略封禁时间的查询上界，Unix 毫秒时间戳，包含边界；省略时不限制上界
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The sort field. blocking_time sorts by the blocking time of the policy (default). blocking_count sorts by the total number of successful task records for the same type and entity. This is not a hit count
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。blocking_time 按策略封禁时点排序（默认），blocking_count 按同类型、同实体的成功任务记录总数排序；并非命中数
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en: The sort direction. asc indicates ascending order, and desc indicates descending order. Default value: desc
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向。asc 表示升序，desc 表示降序；默认降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter for compatibility. This parameter does not control the number of returned records. Use PageSize to set the number of records per page
parameters.help_zh: 兼容保留参数，当前不用于控制返回数量；请使用 PageSize 设置每页条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter for compatibility. This operation does not support cursor-based pagination. Omit this parameter and use Page and PageSize instead. The example value uses JSON double quotes to represent an empty string and is not a valid cursor
parameters.help_zh: 兼容保留参数，本接口不支持游标分页；请省略此参数，使用 Page 和 PageSize。示例以 JSON 的双引号表示空字符串，不是可用游标
parameters.name: next_token

Data.description_en: The business result returned by this operation
Data.description_zh: 本次操作返回的业务结果

List.description_en: The list of blocking policy records on the current page. This list may be empty if no records match
List.description_zh: 本页封禁策略信息列表，无匹配时可能为空

items.description_en: The information about a blocking policy

BlockingCount.description_en: The number of successfully executed task records retained for the same blocking type and entity. This includes blocking, unblocking, modification, and configuration deletion tasks. This is not the number of rule hits. This count is not affected by the start and end time filters of the current request
BlockingCount.description_zh: 同一封禁类型和实体当前保留的执行成功任务记录数，包含封禁、解封、修改及删除配置等任务，不是规则命中次数；此统计不受本次起止时点筛选限制
BlockingCount.title_en: 该实体的封禁任务总次数
BlockingCount.title_zh: 该实体的封禁任务总次数

BlockingDirection.description_en: The blocking direction. in indicates inbound, out indicates outbound, and bidirectional indicates both directions. This value may be empty if the policy is not effective
BlockingDirection.description_zh: 封禁方向。in 表示入方向，out 表示出方向，bidirectional 表示双向。 策略未生效时可能为空

BlockingEntity.description_en: The IPv4 address or domain name of the blocking target
BlockingEntity.description_zh: 封禁对象的 IPv4 地址或域名
BlockingEntity.title_en: 被封禁的实体（IP 或域名）
BlockingEntity.title_zh: 被封禁的实体（IP 或域名）

BlockingExpireTime.description_en: The blocking expiration time, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. 0 indicates that the policy never expires
BlockingExpireTime.description_zh: 封禁过期时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。0 表示永不过期
BlockingExpireTime.title_en: 封禁过期时间戳（毫秒），null 表示永不过期
BlockingExpireTime.title_zh: 封禁过期时间戳（毫秒），null 表示永不过期

BlockingReason.description_en: The blocking reason. This value may be empty
BlockingReason.title_en: 封禁原因摘要，可能为空
BlockingReason.title_zh: 封禁原因摘要，可能为空

BlockingStatus.description_en: The blocking status of the policy. 0 indicates not effective, and 1 indicates effective. To check whether a task is still running, query the task status separately
BlockingStatus.description_zh: 策略封禁状态。0 表示未生效，1 表示已生效；任务是否仍在执行需另查任务状态
BlockingStatus.title_en: 封禁状态：0-未生效 / 1-已生效
BlockingStatus.title_zh: 封禁状态：0-未生效 / 1-已生效

BlockingTime.description_en: The most recent blocking time recorded for the policy, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. When sorting by blocking_count, this value is currently 0 and is not a valid time. To obtain a valid value, sort by blocking_time
BlockingTime.description_zh: 策略记录的最近封禁时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。按 blocking_count 排序时当前为 0，不是有效时点；需要有效值时请按 blocking_time 排序查询

BlockingType.description_en: The object type of the blocking target. ip indicates an IPv4 address, and domain indicates a domain name
BlockingType.description_zh: 封禁对象类型。ip 表示 IPv4 地址，domain 表示域名

PendingTaskCount.description_en: The number of pending or in-progress task records for the same blocking type and entity. This includes blocking and unblocking tasks. This is not the number of policies
PendingTaskCount.description_zh: 同一封禁类型和实体当前待执行或执行中的任务记录数，包含封禁和解封任务，不是策略数量
PendingTaskCount.title_en: 该实体待生效的封禁任务个数
PendingTaskCount.title_zh: 该实体待生效的封禁任务个数

Page.description_en: The page number used for this query, starting from 1
Page.description_zh: 本次查询采用的页码，从 1 开始

PageSize.description_en: The page size used for this query. This value is not equal to the actual number of records returned on the current page
PageSize.description_zh: 本次采用的分页大小，不等于本页实际返回条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of policies that match the filter conditions. This is not the number of records returned on the current page
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的策略总数，不是本页返回条数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. An empty string is returned when the request succeeds. The example value InvalidParam indicates that the request parameters are invalid and does not represent the error code of a successful response
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；成功时为空字符串。示例 InvalidParam 表示请求参数无效，不代表成功响应的错误码

MaxResults.description_en: A reserved field for compatibility. This field does not provide a valid page size. Use Data.PageSize instead. The example value only illustrates the field format
MaxResults.description_zh: 兼容保留字段，当前不提供有效分页大小；请以 Data.PageSize 为准。示例仅说明字段格式

Message.description_en: The description of the request result. The value is success if the request was successful, or an error description if the request failed
Message.description_zh: 本次请求的结果说明；成功时为 success，失败时返回错误说明

NextToken.description_en: A reserved field for compatibility. This operation does not provide a next-page cursor. Use Data.TotalCount, Data.Page, and Data.PageSize for pagination. The example value uses JSON double quotes to represent an empty string and is not a valid cursor
NextToken.description_zh: 兼容保留字段，本接口不提供下一页游标；请依据 Data.TotalCount、Data.Page 和 Data.PageSize 翻页。示例以 JSON 的双引号表示空字符串，不是可用游标

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to troubleshoot and trace this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查和定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call was successful. true indicates that the request was processed successfully, and false indicates a failure. For asynchronous operations, a success response does not indicate that the task has been completed
Success.description_zh: 本次接口调用是否成功。true 表示请求处理成功，false 表示失败；异步接口的成功不表示任务已经执行完成
